sosPage.confirmText:
Please confirm this is a real emergency.
Press SOS to send your current location to the ground station for operator verification.

sosPage.successUavOnly: The UAV confirmed the SOS/GPS was stored onboard. Firebase is currently unavailable.
sosPage.savedLocallyOnly: Neither live receiver accepted the request. A UAV copy remains in the local outbox and expires for sending after 24 hours; reconnect and sync before treating it as delivered.

uav.title: UAV Wi-Fi Receiver
uav.wifiHelp: Android 10+ will show a system confirmation dialog when you sync. The app cannot silently join a Wi-Fi network.
uav.wifiPassphraseHelp: Leave blank only for an open UAV network. WPA2 passphrases must be 8–63 characters and are never written to app storage.
uav.tokenHelp: Held only in memory and cleared when the app process restarts. Pending SOS/GPS copies are persisted separately without this token or the Wi-Fi passphrase; they stop being eligible for sending after 24 hours and are removed on the next outbox access.
uav.testModeOn: TEST is on. Records are explicitly marked as bench-test data.
uav.testModeOff: PRODUCTION is on. Turn this off only for a genuine non-test operation.
uav.testBanner: TEST MODE ACTIVE — GENERATED RECORDS ARE NOT OUTDOOR-FLIGHT EVIDENCE

uav.savedWithoutToken: Receiver URL, UAV Wi-Fi SSID, and mode were saved. No receiver token is active; any Wi-Fi passphrase remains session-only.
uav.invalidUrl: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS receiver URL.
uav.invalidConnection: Check the receiver URL, UAV Wi-Fi SSID, and the 8–63 character WPA2 passphrase.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.message:
Welcome to MyDrone.

By using this app, you agree to the following terms:
- Do not abuse the SOS emergency function
- All uploaded location and personal data are used solely for rescue purposes
- The app assumes no liability for misuse or network-related issues
- We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access for violations

For inquiries, please contact us.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.message:
We take your privacy seriously.

We collect: phone number, real-time location, emergency contacts, medical notes, etc.

Data usage:
- Sending SOS rescue requests
- Recording and displaying your routes
- Assisting rescue coordination

Protection and limits:
- We do not sell or rent your personal data
- Pending UAV SOS/GPS copies stop being eligible for sending after 24 hours and are removed on the next outbox access
- UAV receiver tokens and Wi-Fi passphrases remain in process memory and are never stored with the outbox
- Private-LAN HTTP is not end-to-end encrypted; use it only on the trusted UAV Wi-Fi. Public receiver addresses require HTTPS
- You have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your data at any time

To exercise your rights, please contact us.

systemHealth.title: Mobile Release & Runtime Health
systemHealth.disclaimer: This page shows code and local runtime status only. It contains no phone number, GPS coordinate, receiver address, SSID, token or Wi-Fi password, and it is not proof of a physical flight.

runtime.title: Local readiness
runtime.redaction: Only readiness booleans and counts are shown. Credentials remain in memory; the persistent outbox contains only the allow-listed SOS/GPS record and target binding.

workflow.title: User-confirmed UAV sync flow
workflow.one: The user creates an SOS record with one current GPS point.
workflow.two: The App saves an allow-listed copy in the local outbox with a 24-hour send-eligibility limit; no token or Wi-Fi password is stored.
workflow.three: The user taps Sync and Android displays its own UAV Wi-Fi confirmation dialog.
workflow.four: After user approval, the App binds its traffic to that WLAN and sends the queued record to the configured onboard receiver.
workflow.five: The App accepts only a matching STORED receipt, then releases the WLAN binding and restores the default network.
